summary: This Form 8-K filed by Moog Inc. reports results of operations for the quarter ended March 28, 2026, and announces a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share. No special situation is present; the filing is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration. The dividend will be paid on May 21, 2026 to shareholders of record on May 12, 2026. There are no M&A, activist, or restructuring elements. As a standard current report on financial results and a routine capital return, this is not considered a special-situation event.
